description: Use to find documents to add to a project. mode=search: by words (`query`); mode=suggest: documents likely to answer the questions of `schemas` (refs) or of `project`'s schemas; mode=browse: a corpus's catalogue by words (`query`), `tags` (commodities, series), `who` (operator, author). Narrow by year_from/year_to. corpora default wamex. Returns documents with the corpus and key geothought_add_documents takes.
name: geothought_find_documents
title: Find documents for a project
